name: 3D Aquarium Copenhagen
summary: The aquarium "Blu Planet" in Copenhagen is one of the largest and most beautiful aquariums in the world. Immerse yourself in the underwater world - in 3D. The video shows all the aquariums and fish in maximum quality. When you have seen this video, you will want to go there yourself. You can switch with the buttons on the left controller: X,A: 2D video, Y,B: 3D video. The screen is curved and you can turn your head in front of it for the best 3D experience.
